completion_data.completion_summary: Added a narrowly-gated demotion block to orchestrate-cycle-postflight.sh's WORK (i): a genuinely failed per-cycle commit (exit 2/3/4/5) for a just-completed implement dispatch now demotes state.json to partial, amends the handoff with a blocker, flips verdict to defer, and emits a loud STATUS DEMOTED line. Added both-polarity regression test coverage, documented the sanctioned terminal-state exception in status-markers.md and git-staging-scope.md, and deployed with the scoped gate narrowing confirmed green (full gate-8 battery deferred to this batch's once-per-invocation stage per the dispatch's Batch Gate Deferral directive).
